items.title: George "Happy" Schilling Interview, 1957-09-08
items.q: And, uh, Lefty Ironman. How does Lefty Ironman spell his last name? ... Eddie Ironman. ... And who else was in your band at that time, George? ... I wasn't explaining anyone out at all. And who else was in your band at that time, George?

ctx.x: Yeah, Papa Lane, though, he played with him, too.

Oh, yeah. He played with him, played with Lane before he would play with me. He used to teach music, too. That's right. He'd teach routine, they called it, by numbers. That's how he used to teach them. And he used to rent instruments. He had a room full of instruments. Like all these colored fellas. So much... You want to rent a drum board or rent a drum or rent a horn. He'd rent it to them. He used to make part of money like that, renting. He'd keep a list of them, check on them. They'd bring them back to church…
Well, I was going to ask you a little bit more about Papa Jack Lane's band, his dance band. They weren't legitimate sounding. How did they sound? How were they? Very good. Very good.
